title: Projects
purpose: Find client projects with their number, program, site, manager and standard turnaround. Each chain of custody belongs to one project and inherits its client relationship.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches project name, project number, owning client name, permit or program ID and site or facility.

items.label: Client
items.description: Exact client selection, including inactive clients for historical work.

items.label: Status
items.description: Filters the project’s active flag; blank/All includes both. Client inactivity is a separate restriction.

items.label: Program
items.description: More filters: Any program or one regulatory program (NPDES / Clean Water Act, Industrial pretreatment, Stormwater permit, Drinking water (SDWA), RCRA / waste characterization, Site investigation / remediation, State program, Not regulatory, Other).

items.label: Project manager
items.description: More filters: Any project manager or one active laboratory staff account. A deactivated manager is not offered.

items.label: New project
items.description: Project managers and administrators create a project under an active client.

items.label: Project row link
items.description: Project managers and administrators open the edit form. Other staff see the name as text; there is no separate project detail page.

items.label: Spreadsheet import
items.description: Project managers can also create or change many projects at once from a CSV file under Setup → Spreadsheet import. The file identifies each project by its client's account code and the project name.

items.label: Project
items.description: Project name; default sort is name ascending.

items.label: Number
items.description: Project number, or a dash. Sortable.

items.label: Client
items.description: Owning client organization.

items.label: Program
items.description: Regulatory program category, or a dash. A grouping label, not a compliance or accreditation determination.

items.label: Permit or program ID
items.description: Optional permit number or program label describing this project.

items.label: Site
items.description: Initially hidden. Site or facility, followed by the state of sample origin in parentheses when recorded. Not sortable.

items.label: Project manager
items.description: Assigned laboratory project manager, or a dash. Sorting orders by the manager’s first name.

items.label: Turnaround (days)
items.description: Configured standard project turnaround in days, default 10. It does not automatically assign an order delivery target or analytical holding limit.

items.label: Status
items.description: Project availability for new intake; inactive records and their history remain readable.

sections.title: Table controls
paragraphs: Active laboratory staff can read this list; client portal accounts cannot. Invalid filters show errors and no rows until corrected or cleared. Invalid page sizes are refused. No-match and no-record empty states provide different next steps. Inactive records remain part of historical searches.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines a case-insensitive contains search and selected filters across the complete record set; returns to page 1.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens Program and Project manager and remains open when either is active or invalid.

items.label: Clear all / filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Remove one chip to clear that criterion, preserving the others and returning to page 1.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort all matching records, not just this page. Record ID breaks ties. Unsupported sort values use the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder optional columns. The identifying column remains visible. Browser-local preferences do not change data, search or sort; reset restores default columns.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 25, 50 or 100. Changing size returns to page 1. Use Show when automatic submission is unavailable.

items.label: Pagination
items.description: First, Previous, Next and Last retain filters and sort. The footer gives the visible range and total matching count.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility in this browser.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
